issues.where: the pale animals at the foot of the left wall and along the far shallows over the six-second hold
issues.what: Several animals hold the same hunched silhouette and foot placement for seconds, so they read as posed models even while the water moves.
issues.fix: Give the stationary animals independent head turns and weight shifts, and give the moving ones clear foot plants and releases.

issues.where: the foreground shallows and the bright edge at lower center
issues.what: The bright edge advances and retreats, but the mottled surface behind it keeps much the same pattern, so the water reads more like a moving sheen than a wash over the rocks.
issues.fix: Let the wash carry and break up small foam patches, and change the reflections independently as the water runs around exposed stones.

issues.where: the low flyers crossing the shallows at left and center, also visible in set-B-02.png
issues.what: The bodies translate low over the water while the extended wings and body pitch change very little, making the flyers look as if they slide along a plane.
issues.fix: Give each flyer a different bank or wing adjustment and let its height and pitch respond as it clears the rocks.
